user.title: Connect to openGym
user.description: If you run the openGym add-on, Home Assistant finds it on its own — accept the discovered entry instead. Otherwise enter where the openGym gateway listens and its integration token (stored on the openGym host in `/data/gateway/integration_token`).

data_description.host: A hostname or IP address only, without http:// or a path.
data_description.port: The gateway port; the add-on uses 8099.

hassio_confirm.title: openGym add-on found
hassio_confirm.description:
The add-on **{addon}** (`{slug}`) announced an openGym server. Set it up? Each openGym profile becomes a device with body weight, last workout and today's routine sensors. Only continue if this is the openGym add-on you installed.

If you already added openGym by hand using an IP address, remove that entry first so it is not set up twice.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate openGym
reauth_confirm.description: openGym at {host} rejected the stored integration token. If you run the openGym add-on, restart it: it advertises its token again and Home Assistant picks it up. Otherwise enter the token from `/data/gateway/integration_token` on the openGym host.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach openGym. Check the host and port, and that openGym is running.
error.invalid_auth: openGym rejected the integration token. Check that you copied the whole token.
error.invalid_host: Enter a hostname or IP address only, without http:// or a path.

abort.already_configured: This openGym is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this openGym is already in progress.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the openGym add-on. Start it, then try again from Settings → Devices & services.
abort.invalid_auth: The openGym add-on rejected its own token. Restart the add-on, then try again.
abort.not_opengym_addon: The add-on {addon} (`{slug}`) announced itself as openGym, but openGym is set up from a different add-on. Nothing was changed. If you reinstalled openGym from another repository, delete the openGym integration and add it again.

entry_not_found.message: No openGym entry with id {entry_id}. Pick the openGym instance again.

entry_not_loaded.message: openGym is not loaded. Check Settings → Devices & services, then try again.

entry_required.message: More than one openGym is set up. Choose which one with config_entry_id.

unknown_profile.message: No openGym profile matches "{profile}". Use the id or the exact name of one of: {candidates}.

ambiguous_profile.message: More than one openGym profile is called "{profile}": {candidates}. Use the id of the one you mean.

invalid_weigh_in.message: openGym refused this weigh-in. Use a weight between 0 and 700 kg (1543 lb) and a valid date.

profile_not_found.message: openGym no longer has the profile "{profile}". It may have been deleted or disabled; check the profile list in openGym.

profile_conflict.message: openGym could not save the weigh-in for "{profile}": the profile changed while saving, or it has no data yet. Try again; if it keeps failing, log something in openGym as that person first (a workout, a weigh-in or any setting).

invalid_auth.message: openGym rejected the integration token. Re-authenticate the openGym integration.

request_failed.message: openGym refused the request (HTTP {status}). Try again; if it keeps failing, check the openGym add-on log.

not_responding.message: openGym is not responding. Check that the openGym add-on is running, then try again.

log_body_weight.name: Log body weight
log_body_weight.description: Records a weigh-in on an openGym profile, for example from a smart scale. A profile keeps one weigh-in per day, so a second one on the same day replaces the first.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: The profile's id, or its exact name (not case-sensitive).

weight.name: Weight
weight.description: The measured weight. openGym converts it to the profile's own unit.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Unit of the weight. Defaults to lb with a US customary unit system, otherwise kg.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day of the weigh-in. Defaults to today in Home Assistant's time zone.

config_entry_id.name: openGym instance
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one openGym is set up.

get_summary.name: Get summary
get_summary.description: Returns each profile's body weight, last workout, workout counts and today's routine, as of the last poll (every minute).

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Only return this profile (id or exact name). Leave empty for all profiles.

config_entry_id.name: openGym instance
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one openGym is set up.
